correctness.rationale: Proof covers every integer s>=1, positive multipartite part sizes and real h>=0: (i) coefficient ratio monotonicity proves g_s=(1-R_s)/z strictly decreasing, (ii) explicit mutually orthogonal Laplacian projectors yield strictly positive off-diagonal formulas, (iii) integral positivity of Q_s(-z) for even s yields positive diagonal and SPD, (iv) odd-s limit (2/N)J-I forces negative diagonals for N>=3, while the exact 2x2 formula and -1<R_s<1 handles N=2. Exact rational program checks 231 examples but is not used as a proof for infinitely many stages or graphs.

value.rationale: Exact unbounded-stage classification yields unconditional completed-step positivity, stochasticity and positive definiteness for arbitrarily high even-order Gauss collocation on a natural infinite family of connected heat networks, while explaining odd-stage failure and universal off-diagonal positivity. This distinguishes numerical positivity from unconditional global RK SSP constraints, generalizing finite-stage instances nontrivially with a new coefficient-ratio proof. Offers practical method selection for these graphs and a testable scalar monotonicity mechanism without making unsupported claims outside the family. As h grows without bound the even-stage map tends to I; the result concerns positivity rather than stiff-limit accuracy.
